svg.text: One dispatch per visit: a hint issued now, a memory access consumed later
Each round visits every resident task once. A visit consumes the access its previous visit hinted, advances the task’s state and, before yielding, hints the next
access. The other tasks’ visits put distance between a hint and its use. A sibling created by a split hints at creation but joins the rounds only after admission.

States of a task, one dispatch per visit
Navy: continuation on the next task visit. Green: direct handler call within the same visit. Hints are issued where needed before yielding.
Done marks completion and is retired at round end; it is not another dispatched visit.
